rule: When a shared-stream poll task dies, remove the group from SharedStreamManager._groups immediately (or mark it dead) so that late subscribers are not attached to a group whose _poll will never produce items
trigger: A _poll or equivalent coroutine fans out a failure sentinel to subscribers and returns without removing its group from the manager registry
rationale: A late subscriber arriving between _PollFailure broadcast and the last unsubscribe gets a fresh queue that nothing ever fills; its _drain blocks on queue.get() forever with no log line and no recovery path

evidence.excerpt: late subscriber joins a group whose poll task is already dead

rule: Never manually edit auto-generated OpenAPI client files (openapi-gen/); all changes must be produced by regenerating via the configured @hey-api/openapi-ts command
trigger: A diff modifies files under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/openapi-gen/ without an accompanying update to the OpenAPI spec or generation script
rationale: Manual edits to generated artifacts are silently overwritten by the next regeneration, making the change invisible and unreviewable as a spec change

evidence.excerpt: ensure new field comes from regenerating OpenAPI client artifacts, not manual edits

rule: When using raw fetch() inside a React Query hook, attach the HTTP status code to any thrown Error so the global QueryClient retry guard (which checks error.status) can skip retries on 4xx responses
trigger: A useQuery queryFn calls fetch() directly and throws a plain Error (without a .status property) on non-OK responses
rationale: queryClient.ts retry logic checks error.status to suppress retries for 4xx; a plain Error has status=undefined, causing spurious retries on 401/403 for every task-instance page load

evidence.excerpt: error.status is undefined here, it'll retry 3 times for 401/403 responses

rule: Guard plugin-specific React Query hooks with an enabled check that verifies the relevant plugin tab is present before firing any network request
trigger: A useQuery hook for an optional plugin feature (e.g. HITL review) sets enabled only from an outer boolean, without also checking whether the plugin's tab exists in the tabs array
rationale: Most Airflow deployments do not install optional plugins; firing a fetch on every task-instance page load for an absent plugin wastes network traffic at scale

evidence.excerpt: skip the request entirely when the tab doesn't exist; most Airflow deployments don't use HITL

rule: A new translation locale must have an identified translation owner approved via the dev list before merge, and must include a locale-specific guide file at .github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/<code>.md
trigger: A PR adds a new locale directory under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/public/i18n/locales/ without a corresponding .github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/<code>.md file
rationale: The i18n process requires approved ownership and a locale guide to keep translation quality consistent and to provide instructions for future LLM-assisted or human contributors

evidence.excerpt: enforce that each new language creates a .github/skills/airflow-translations/locales/<code>.md file

rule: i18next plural key sets must be fully consistent with how the key is consumed in code; if only the _one suffix is used directly, the plural form must either be added to the codebase or the extra key removed
trigger: A locale JSON file adds both _one and _other plural variants for a key but the TypeScript/TSX consumer references only one of the variants directly as a string literal
rationale: Unused plural keys indicate a mismatch between i18n data and the calling code; the pluralisation feature only works when the caller passes a count parameter via the i18next translate() API

evidence.excerpt: we don't use anything other than error_one directly, which is probably wrong itself

rule: i18n keys for input placeholders must carry a Placeholder suffix (e.g. runIdFilterPlaceholder) to match existing key conventions and enable key reuse across locales
trigger: A locale JSON file adds filter or input-hint keys without a Placeholder suffix
rationale: The Airflow i18n convention groups placeholder strings under keys with a Placeholder suffix; omitting it creates duplicates and breaks reuse of already-translated strings

evidence.excerpt: Those should also have 'Placeholder' suffix; we might want to regroup them

rule: Do not pass a non-datetime string literal to the Airflow UI <Time datetime={...}> component; use a real ISO timestamp or leave the prop null/undefined and drive visual state from count fields
trigger: A TSX file assigns a string literal (e.g. 'received') to a property that is passed as the datetime prop of <Time>
rationale: The <Time> component renders its datetime value as a formatted date; passing an arbitrary string produces an invalid date display or runtime error

evidence.excerpt: Passing 'received' as a datetime will likely render an invalid date/time

rule: Use Chakra UI numeric token values (e.g. height={5}) instead of CSS pixel strings (e.g. height="20px") for sizing props in Airflow UI components
trigger: A Chakra UI component in the Airflow UI receives a size prop expressed as a quoted pixel string rather than a numeric token
rationale: The Airflow UI uses Chakra's design-token scale throughout; mixing raw CSS strings breaks visual consistency and bypasses the token system

evidence.excerpt: height and width should use Chakra numeric tokens, not pixel strings
